script.prompt:
Russian dialogue for a fictional family cartoon game. Original character interpretation, not a real actor imitation. Friendly youthful male cartoon pig, rounded warm slightly nasal high-mid voice. Keep only the short stutters written in the text, do not add excessive stuttering. Helpful, expressive and clear. Natural clear brisk delivery, finish the words in about 9.9 seconds. Speak every written word once and fully; no added words, laughs, introduction, conclusion or numbering. Preserve only stutters explicitly written in the text. No music or effects. Leave 0.4 seconds of silence before the first word and after the last word. Do not clip the first or last consonants. Do not exaggerate speech impediments; each word must stay intelligible.

Н-на следующих уровнях т-ты сможешь найти салат не только на о-огородах. Но н-не б-беспокойся, он всегда будет п-показан на твоей к-карте.
